rca_of_the_issue: Bug1 root cause: pre-auth-pivot projects were created with only creator_email and no owner_user_id. Post-pivot, GET /api/projects filtered strictly on owner_user_id, hiding legacy projects. Fix layered — (a) list_my_projects auto-claims via update_many on the OR of missing/empty/null owner_user_id, (b) _get_owned_project_or_404 matches OR(owner_user_id, creator_email) and lazily backfills. Both paths use case-insensitive regex on creator_email so casing variance doesn't lose projects. Bug2 root cause: the app-shell was scrolling as a whole, dragging the sidebar off-screen. Fix isolates main scroll via a 3-part CSS pattern (shell overflow:hidden + main overflow-y:auto + sidebar sticky/h100vh). Bug3 root cause: Haiku prose quality for step outputs was thin; swapping DEFAULT_MODEL to Sonnet 4.5 restores structured, opinionated outputs while keeping SUGGEST_MODEL on Haiku for keystroke latency.
